After fixes (47 rows), average body_mass_g by species: Adelie ≈ 3694.44 g, Chinstrap ≈ 3801.79 g, Gentoo ≈ 5173.33 g. Caveat: excluded rows are removed from analysis; sex missing values (2) were left as-is per rules.
